Lintec.why: Makes semiconductor-related adhesive tapes and multilayer ceramic capacitor-related tape whose sales grow with AI data center demand.
Lintec.evidence: Lintec Q1 FY ending March 2027 results (08-06-2026): semiconductor-related adhesive tapes and multilayer ceramic capacitor-related tape continued to perform well due to increased demand related to AI data centers and smartphones.

players.product: Semiconductor-related adhesive tapes and semiconductor-related devices

quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec quarterly financial report: Consolidated Financial Results for the First Quarter of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY ending March 2027 (April-June 2026): net sales JPY 83,178 million (up 7.9% YoY) as semiconductor and electronic component-related products continued to perform strongly due to increased AI-related demand; operating income JPY 6,873 million (up 18.4%) despite a significant increase in procurement costs for naphtha-derived raw materials due to Middle East tensions
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 83,178 million (+7.9%); operating income JPY 6,873 million (+18.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Lintec quarterly financial report: Consolidated Financial Results for the First Quarter of the Fiscal Year Ending March 31, 2027 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronic and Optical Products segment net sales JPY 25,481 million (up 11.9%) and operating income JPY 5,756 million (up 21.5%). Advanced Materials Operations net sales JPY 23,810 million (up 15.9%): sales of semiconductor-related devices decreased, but semiconductor-related adhesive tapes and multilayer ceramic capacitor-related tape continued to perform well on increased demand related to AI data centers and smartphones
